system.description: Combatants who have pushed their physical capabilities through discipline, experience, or relentless conditioning — brawlers, duelists, soldiers, martial artists, bodyguards.
system.benefit: Gain one additional Prowess Expertise and two additional Prowess Action Cards. If acquired later: instead increase Prowess to a minimum of 2 pips, then gain one additional Prowess Expertise and four additional Prowess Action Cards.

origin.name: Peak Performance
origin.text: Increase your Resilience by 1. During your first turn, Movement that brings you closer to an enemy costs half as much Movement.
